rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of FRIGG, the greatest Norse goddess taking protective oaths from all things animate and inanimate across the Nine Realms.
ANATOMY: One adult female goddess, one head, two eyes, two arms, two legs, five natural fingers on each hand. Fully opaque thick WALNUT ceremonial gown, high closed neckline, antique-gold mantle covering torso and legs. Natural severe dignified maternal face; no crown, no weapon, no spindle, no animal iconography attributed to her. [frigg-c01, frigg-c02]
MOMENT: Command the universal protective promise with a broad OPEN PALM descending toward the oath gathering, opposite hand raised in solemn decree, mouth open as she speaks. Her enormous foreground palm and stern face look DOWN toward the viewer. Far below her, a semicircle of tiny fully clothed adult witnesses kneel and raise oath hands, ordinary wolves and a stag lower their heads. Among them are rough stones and forged iron pieces placed inward, a leaning tree at each side and one small ordinary brazier flame. All visibly attend her; Frigg is unmistakably the sovereign recipient rather than one member of a human gathering. [frigg-c10]
POWER: Oaths from animate and inanimate things that they will not harm her son. Represent physical oath posture and spoken decree only: no destructive power, no levitation, no moving metal, no supernatural flame, no glowing runes. Fire, metal, stone, trees, people and beasts are illustrative examples of animate/inanimate categories, not a new magic mechanism. [frigg-c10]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low ground-level view from within the oath gathering; Frigg fills 85 percent of the square from hem to stern head, towering visually above the tiny oath participants. Treat this MONUMENTAL DIVINE SCALE as an editorial allegory of greatest-goddess status and universal oath, not a claim of canonical giant size. Raised commanding hands loom nearer than her face. Entire full figure remains visible, she is no ordinary human-size woman. [frigg-c02,frigg-c10]
LIGHT & WEATHER: one strong low warm light from the ordinary foreground brazier illuminates her severe face, open palm and vast woven mantle from below; deep black background, thin atmospheric haze but NO glowing aura or supernatural clouds.
SURFACE: extremely tactile opaque woven cloth, bronze-gold thread catching firelight, natural mature skin, rough rocks, matte iron, bark and shaggy animal fur.
SETTING: Unspecified dark terrain where she gathers oaths during her journey throughout the Nine Realms. No invented Fensalir palace or throne. Keep background minimal behind towering subject. [frigg-c10]
MOOD: Respectful sacred awe, overwhelming royal maternal authority, all existence attending her protective decree; decisive and imposing, never ordinary woman at human scale, cute, calm social gathering, or evil monster.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no film game anime comic designs; fully opaque clothing, no nudity or gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons, magical particles, floating objects, invented crown, throne or prophecy image.

artistic_choices: Monumental divine scale is a compositional allegory under GAMBAR §5/§6.5, not a sourced assertion of literal giant anatomy.
No throne/hall: c08 only supplies unlocated Fensalir realm; oath-gathering c10 is used as the scene instead.

Beasts, people, trees, rough stones, forged metal and an ordinary flame exemplify animate/inanimate categories c10. Specific participants and arrangement are editorial. No levitation, bending metal, magically warping trees, flying rocks, prophecy vision or generic aura.
Fully opaque walnut gown and antique gold mantle are dignified editorial clothing, not claimed documented iconography.
